fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn using STRPluginMessagingAPI, with mandatory pre-UI consent, native multi-master scene controls, participant-authored OStim alignment plus clock-calibrated phase replay for free scenes, read-only local/proxy role diagnostics, safe orphan proxy-thread cleanup, OCum live scene polling for RaceMenu overlays and OStim equip-object meshes, idempotent shared speed control, and Skyrim-Souls-safe message boxes.
